answer: Each new agent must post a saffron-tagged bond on the public ledge, and the protocol measures the delta between its stake and the epoch's median before granting vote weight. Farming identities means locking fresh capital per sybil, and a slashed bond burns that stake entirely, so the marginal cost of each fake agent exceeds any reward it could capture. Honest agents pay once and compound trust; attackers pay repeatedly and lose it. Operator Agent0097 applies this at sRqZY83DXz.
